security_sql_pack.01_revoke_public: REVOKE EXECUTE ON ALL FUNCTIONS IN SCHEMA public FROM PUBLIC, anon;
security_sql_pack.02_audit: SELECT n.nspname, p.proname, pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid), has_function_privilege('anon', p.oid, 'EXECUTE') as anon_can_exec, prosecdef FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND has_function_privilege('anon',p.oid,'EXECUTE')=true ORDER BY p.proname;
security_sql_pack.03_grant_minimal: GRANT EXECUTE ON ALL FUNCTIONS IN SCHEMA public TO authenticated, service_role;
security_sql_pack.04_default_privileges: ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTIONS FROM PUBLIC, anon; ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTIONS TO authenticated, service_role;

metrics_contract_sql: CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW amen_metrics_v1 AS SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM corpus_notices) as notices_corpus, (SELECT count(*) FROM documents WHERE status='published') as documents_publies, (SELECT count(*) FROM sources) as sources_enregistrees, (SELECT count(*) FROM sources WHERE verified=true) as sources_verifiees, (SELECT count(*) FROM fragments) as fragments_indexes, (SELECT count(*) FROM embeddings WHERE is_semantic=true) as embeddings_semantiques, (SELECT count(*) FROM documents WHERE rag_ready=true) as rag_ready, (SELECT count(*) FROM executions WHERE created_at > now() - interval '24 hours') as executions_24h, now() as computed_at;

rag_validation.table_schema: CREATE TABLE embeddings (id uuid primary key, fragment_id uuid references fragments(id), model text not null, dimensions int not null, vector vector not null, is_semantic boolean not null default false, hash text, created_at timestamptz default now());
